data.description:
## testing_mode: GREEN

## Task

Update `_phase_remediate` in `plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-pr.sh` to implement the 4-tier priority loop, making the T3 RED tests pass.

## Changes required

### _phase_remediate refactor

Replace the current single-tier normalization block (Steps 3-8) with a priority loop:

```bash
# Current (single-tier):
_normalize_tier1 "$_raw_findings" "$_normalized" 2>/dev/null || { ...; return 2; }
_dispatch_fix_agent "$_normalized" || ...; return 2
git add -u / commit / push
_phase_poll ...

# New (4-tier loop):
local _tier _tier_artifact _tier_log_file _tier_normalized _tier_rc
for _tier in 1 2 3 4; do
    _tier_normalized=$(mktemp /tmp/dso-normalized-tier${_tier}.XXXXXX)
    
    # Find tier-specific artifact
    _tier_artifact=''
    case "$_tier" in
        1) _tier_artifact=$(find "$_artifacts_dir" -name 'reviewer-findings.json' -maxdepth 3 | head -1) ;;
        2) _tier_artifact=$(find "$_artifacts_dir" -name 'test-results*.json' -maxdepth 3 | head -1) ;;
        3) _tier_artifact=$(find "$_artifacts_dir" -name 'lint-results*.json' -maxdepth 3 | head -1) ;;
        4) : ;;
    esac
    
    # Log fallback when no artifact
    _tier_log_file=''
    if [[ -z "$_tier_artifact" ]]; then
        _tier_log_file=$(mktemp /tmp/dso-ci-log.XXXXXX)
        if ! _fetch_ci_log "$_failed_run_id" "$_tier_log_file" 2>/dev/null; then
            rm -f "$_tier_log_file" "$_tier_normalized"
            continue
        fi
        _tier_artifact="$_tier_log_file"
    fi
    
    # Normalize
    _tier_rc=0
    case "$_tier" in
        1) _normalize_tier1 "$_tier_artifact" "$_tier_normalized" 2>/dev/null || _tier_rc=$? ;;
        2) _normalize_tier2 "$_tier_artifact" "$_tier_normalized" 2>/dev/null || _tier_rc=$? ;;
        3) _normalize_tier3 "$_tier_artifact" "$_tier_normalized" 2>/dev/null || _tier_rc=$? ;;
        4) _normalize_tier4 "$_tier_artifact" "$_tier_normalized" 2>/dev/null || _tier_rc=$? ;;
    esac
    [[ -n "$_tier_log_file" ]] && rm -f "$_tier_log_file"
    
    if [[ "$_tier_rc" -ne 0 ]]; then
        rm -f "$_tier_normalized"
        continue  # ARTIFACT_MISSING (3) or parse error
    fi
    
    # Dispatch
    _tier_dispatch_rc=0
    _dispatch_fix_agent "$_tier_normalized" 2>/dev/null || _tier_dispatch_rc=$?
    rm -f "$_tier_normalized"
    [[ "$_tier_dispatch_rc" -ne 0 ]] && continue
    
    # CI guard (same as before)
    [[ "${CI:-}" != 'true' ]] && { echo 'WARNING: remediate push skipped outside CI' >&2; continue; }
    
    # Push
    git add -u 2>/dev/null || true
    git commit -m "fix: CI remediation tier${_tier} [skip ci]" 2>/dev/null || { continue; }
    git push origin HEAD 2>/dev/null || continue
    
    # Re-poll
    if _phase_poll "$_pr_number" "$_pr_url"; then
        rm -rf "$_artifacts_dir"
        return 0
    fi
    # Still failing — try next tier
done

rm -rf "$_artifacts_dir"
return 2
```

### Wire up _fetch_ci_log from normalize lib
The `_fetch_ci_log` function is defined in ci-findings-normalize.sh. Ensure it is sourced before the `_phase_remediate` call site:
- The file is already sourced via the CI_FINDINGS_LIB_MODE=1 source on line ~76
- Verify _fetch_ci_log is accessible (defined before the guard) after T2 implementation

## Additional: source guard update
After T2 is implemented, verify that CI_FINDINGS_LIB_MODE sourcing line (line ~76 of merge-to-main-pr.sh) picks up the new functions. No change required if they are defined before the guard.

## Files to modify
- plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-pr.sh (_phase_remediate function)
